parameters.content:
## BizOS 06 — Sale Invoice Creation

**4 webhook routes:**
1. GET /webhook/bizos-invoice-form → Form HTML (customers from DB)
2. POST /webhook/bizos-invoice-submit → Insert draft → Approval page
3. POST /webhook/bizos-invoice-approve → Post to books + audit_log
4. POST /webhook/bizos-invoice-reject → Cancel draft + audit_log

**HTML files:** /home/node/.n8n/bizos06/
**tenant_id = 1 (fixed)**

parameters.query: SELECT id, name FROM customers WHERE tenant_id = 1 ORDER BY name ASC

headers.user-agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/153.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

nodeGroups.name: Route 1 – Serve Invoice Form
nodeGroups.description: GET /webhook/bizos-invoice-form → fetch customers from DB → inject into HTML → respond

nodeGroups.name: Route 2 – Draft Invoice + Approval
nodeGroups.description: POST submit → normalize → insert draft invoice → fetch customer name → build approval page → respond

nodeGroups.name: Route 3 – Approve Invoice
nodeGroups.description: POST approve → normalize → UPDATE status=posted → audit_log → success page

nodeGroups.name: Route 4 – Reject Invoice
nodeGroups.description: POST reject → normalize → UPDATE status=cancelled → audit_log → rejection page
